name: Xpertdezine Product Inquiry Manager
author: Muhammad Ali Khizar

sections.description:
Xpertdezine Product Inquiry Manager is a powerful and flexible plugin that allows you to add inquiry/quote request buttons to any product type – WooCommerce products, custom post types, or any post type on your WordPress site.

Key Features

  • ✅ Universal Compatibility – Works with WooCommerce products, Custom Post Types, and any post type
  • ✅ Beautiful Modal Form – Professional popup form with validation
  • ✅ Admin Dashboard – Complete analytics with charts and graphs
  • ✅ Email Notifications – Automatic email alerts for new inquiries
  • ✅ Bulk Actions – Select, update, and delete multiple inquiries at once
  • ✅ CSV Export – Export all inquiries to CSV format
  • ✅ Status Management – Mark inquiries as pending or completed
  • ✅ Advanced Filters – Filter by status, date, or search by name/email/product
  • ✅ Shortcode Support – Add inquiry button anywhere with [pim_xd_inquiry_button]
  • ✅ Customizable – Change button text, color, and fields visibility
  • ✅ Responsive Design – Works perfectly on all devices
  • ✅ Translation Ready – Easily translate to any language

Why Choose Xpertdezine Product Inquiry Manager?

Unlike other inquiry plugins that only work with WooCommerce, Xpertdezine Product Inquiry Manager works with ANY product type. Whether you’re using WooCommerce, a custom product CPT, or any other post type, this plugin has you covered.

Perfect for:
– WooCommerce stores wanting quote requests
– Custom product directories
– Service providers needing client inquiries
– Any business with products/services listed on WordPress

Shortcodes

[pim_xd_inquiry_button]

Display inquiry button on any page/post

[pim_xd_inquiry_button product_id="123"]

Display inquiry button for specific product by ID

Dashboard Features

  • Real-time Statistics – Total, pending, completed, and today’s inquiries
  • Monthly Charts – Visual representation of inquiry trends
  • Status Distribution – Pie chart showing pending vs completed
  • Daily Trends – Line chart for last 7 days activity
  • Top Products – Most inquired products with progress bars
  • Recent Inquiries – Latest 5 inquiries with quick status update

Languages

  • English (default)

Credits

Developed by Muhammad Ali Khizar

Support

For support, feature requests, or bug reports, please visit:
https://xpertdezineit.com/contact-us/

License

This plugin is licensed under GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the product-inquiry-manager-by-xd folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Product Inquiry → Settings to configure the plugin
  4. Customize button text, colors, and field visibility
  5. The inquiry button will automatically appear on all WooCommerce and CPT products

Manual Installation

You can also add the inquiry button manually using shortcodes:
[pim_xd_inquiry_button]

Or with specific product ID:
[pim_xd_inquiry_button product_id=”123″]
sections.faq:
Does this work with WooCommerce?

Yes, it works perfectly with WooCommerce products out of the box.

Does this work with Custom Post Types?

Yes, it works with any custom post type. Just enable it in settings.

Can I change the button text and color?

Yes, you can customize both from the settings page.

How do I view all inquiries?

Go to Product Inquiry → All Inquiries in your WordPress admin.

Can I export inquiries?

Yes, you can export all inquiries to CSV format from the All Inquiries page.

Does it send email notifications?

Yes, admin receives email notification for every new inquiry. You can configure the recipient email in settings.

Is it mobile responsive?

Yes, the inquiry form and dashboard are fully responsive.

Can I use shortcodes?

Yes, use [pim_xd_inquiry_button] shortcode anywhere on your site.

Is it translation ready?

Yes, the plugin is fully translation ready with text domain product-inquiry-manager-by-xd.

Will it work with my theme?

Yes, it works with any WordPress theme.
